programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Malawi is a small East African country.Martyna Wojciechowska visits Theresa Kachindamoto, who lives and works in the Dedza district.She is called the Terminator by the inhabitants of the country.She was born into a tribal royal family, the youngest of thirteen siblings.When her eldest brother died, the rest of her siblings elected her as the leader of the almost million-strong community.Never before has a woman performed such an important function.Thanks to her rule, Theresa gained fame and notoriety.During the dozen or so years she was in power, she opposed the customs of the time, annulling over five thousand marriages of underage girls.However, the activities of the heroine of the episode are appreciated not only in her country.At the White House, she received the Local Community Leader award from Michelle Obama and Hillary Clinton.Thanks to Chief Kachindamoto, thousands of underage women were able to return to school - previously 40% of them were married off before they turned 18.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Georgia, there is a clear division into female and male roles.Women have to take care of the house and give birth to children, while men work.In the Caucasus, family is the most valuable, infertility is a taboo topic.Mariam Kukunashvili helps couples, including homosexual ones, who want to have children but are struggling with difficulties.She created a network of clinics, and today she is one of the most influential and richest women in the country.She was inspired by her own story - to become a mother, she underwent many years of treatment, struggled with difficult experiences, and finally used the help of surrogates.Patients can benefit from in vitro treatment, the services of surrogate mothers or an egg bank.Similar practices are a controversial topic in Georgia, especially among women.Mariam Kukunashvili breaks stereotypes in the context of traditional society.Its activities have expanded to other parts of the world, including:Ukraine, South Africa, Mexico and Kenya.Thanks to this, 7,000 children from 70 countries have already been born.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Kenya, located in East Africa, is inhabited by 55 million people, over 40 different tribes who speak almost 70 languages ​​in total.Although there is a real mosaic of cultures and beliefs there, not everyone is accepted, and being different can even cost your life.Martyna Wojciechowska visits this republic to meet Darlan.She claims to be the first outed intersex person in her country.Today, he is popular, sings, records music videos, designs clothes, and preaches tolerance.However, this was not always the case.A child born with sexual organs different from those typical of a boy or girl may be considered a curse on the community and killed.Darlan's childhood was marked by humiliation, sarcastic remarks, but also attacks and loneliness.Currently he is fighting for "others".The Darlan Rukih Church is one of the 4,000 officially registered in Kenya and has half a million believers.He cares for all those who are rejected.

programme.desc: Marcin Prokop will go on a spontaneous journey around America in a program full of humor.During his journey across the United States, which lasts over a month, the journalist will cover thousands of kilometers.Viewers will have the opportunity to see the alleys of the largest Chinese district in the US, find themselves behind the walls of the most famous prison, Alcatraz, and look out the window of the tallest skyscraper in San Francisco.The host will stop at the world's largest stop for giant trucks, visit a hippie town and visit a unique restaurant connected to a laundry.The audience will be able to feast their eyes on amazing landscapes, unique national parks and wonderful waterfalls In this episode, Marcin will go to San Francisco.The presenter will cross the Golden Gate Bridge, where Agent 007 fought a murderous fight with Max Zorin in the film about the adventures of James Bond.He will also visit the colorful Castro district, where Harvey Milk once fought for gay rights.Then he will go to the Haight-Ashbury district, the cradle of hippies, where Marcin will undergo a surprising metamorphosis.A visit to this city would not be complete without a trip to Lombard Street, known as the most twisted street in the world.After a walk through the city streets, the presenter will take us to the most liberal beach in California and show us the famous Alcatraz prison, where Al Capone ended his gangster career.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Sally Mae Hassona grew up in Australia.When she was very young, she started training kickboxing, then football, and in 2012 she became interested in boxing.That's how she got into the amateur league.As a talented player, she won the Golden Gloves Championship.Some time later she became a trainer.Together with her Egyptian husband, they are the parents of two children.They moved to Cairo four years ago.Women's boxing is a completely new phenomenon in this city.Society often cannot accept that women practice this "men's sport".However, Sally Mae Hassona decided to start her own boxing academy: Impact Sports Academy.There he trains girls and boys from poor families.She also hopes that in the future, her students' fighting skills will enable them to defend themselves against violence.Some of Sally's students successfully participate in competitions organized by the federation in Egypt.The woman's children also train, and her son became a boxing champion.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again managed to reach the titular "end of the world", despite restrictions, difficulties in traveling, and the fact that the thirteenth series of the program could have been the unlucky one.During the uncertain time of the pandemic, she showed viewers moving stories that gave hope that miracles can be achieved even in the most difficult circumstances.She produced an extraordinary series of stories from Dubai, Georgia, Kenya, Malawi, Egypt and Romania.Now viewers will learn the behind-the-scenes of all these expeditions.For the host of the program, it is also a sentimental journey - one of the heroines of the reports, Raha Moharrak, just like her, reached for the Crown of the Earth, and in the desert in Dubai, Martyna Wojciechowska met her colleagues from the Dakar Rally: Marek Dąbrowski and Jacek Czachor.In Kenya, she appeared in a music video for a gospel song by Darlan Rukish.However, during filming in Malawi, she refused to eat a roasted mouse.This is just some of the information that will appear in the episode.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world The whole world heard about Anja Ringgren Loven in 2016.All because of a photo showing a woman giving water to an extremely exhausted two-year-old who was close to death in a Nigerian village.The boy accused of witchcraft was driven out of his home.He wandered for a long time before help arrived.In Nigeria, they still believe in magic and use it to explain all misfortunes and accidents.People living in poverty and deprived of the opportunity for education may, under the pretext of accusing them of witchcraft, get rid of another person to feed from their home.Martyna Wojciechowska's heroine, Anja, has been active in this country for years.She founded the "Land of Hope" organization, which deals with rescuing and providing a safe haven for children suspected of being associated with evil forces.
